widget_values_sig:
'[About API Node](https://docs.comfy.org/tutorials/api-nodes/overview) | [关于 API 节点](https://docs.comfy.org/zh-CN/tutorials/api-nodes/overview)

To use the API, you must be in a secure network environment:

- Allows access from `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`.

- Use our API Node in website services starting with `https`

- Make sure you can normally connect to our API services (some regions may need a proxy).

- Make sure you are logged in in the settings and that your account still has enough credits to cover the consumption of API calls.

- On non-whitelisted sites or local area networks (LANs), please try to [log in using an API Key](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/user#logging-in-with-an-api-key).

---

要使用API，你必须处于安全的网络环境中：

- 允许从`127.0.0.1`或`localhost`访问。
- 在带有 https 开头的服务中使用我们的 API Node
- 确保你能够正常连接我们的API服务（某些地区可能需要代理）。
- 确保你已在设置中登录，且你的账户仍有足够的积分来支付API调用的消耗。
- 在非白名单站点或者局域网（LAN），请尝试[使用 API Key 来登录](https://docs.comfy.org/zh-CN/interface/user#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8-api-key-%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E7%99%BB%E5%BD%95)
'

'Output model will be auto saved to "ComfyUI/output/Rodin3D"

Or you can use the export function in the preview 3D node to download it.

---

输出模型将自动保存到 “ComfyUI/output/Rodin3D”。

或者你可以使用 3D 预览节点中的导出功能来下载它。'

"Try to provide the following types of images:
- Provide images from multiple angles.
- Images with a solid color background.

This helps to generate a model that better meets the requirements. Of course, thanks to Rodin's excellent product capabilities, the subject in the unprocessed image can also achieve a good model output.  

---

尽量提供下面的图片类型：
- 提供多角度
- 纯色背景的图片

这有助于生成更符合要求的模型，当然依托于 Rodin 的优秀的产品能力，未经处理的图片中的主体也获得不错的模型输出"
'The larger the Polygon_count, the more detailed the model.\n\nPolygon_count 越大模型越精细'

'Rodin provides model generation APIs with different levels of precision. You can set the corresponding nodes to the "always" mode according to your requirements.  

---

Rodin 提供了不同精度的模型生成 API，你可以按需要将对应的节点设置为 always 模式'

_ui.title: Tips
widgets_values:
Try to provide the following types of images:
- Provide images from multiple angles.
- Images with a solid color background.

This helps to generate a model that better meets the requirements. Of course, thanks to Rodin's excellent product capabilities, the subject in the unprocessed image can also achieve a good model output.  

---

尽量提供下面的图片类型：
- 提供多角度
- 纯色背景的图片

这有助于生成更符合要求的模型，当然依托于 Rodin 的优秀的产品能力，未经处理的图片中的主体也获得不错的模型输出
